summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of R. Alexandra Keith as a Non-Executive Director, effective 5 November 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the Annual General Meeting. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, transaction mechanics, or strategic actions are involved. The filing solely covers a board member appointment and committee memberships. As a routine board appointment announcement, it does not qualify as a special-situation category such as acquisitions, management changes, or other listed events. No further action or risk-arbitrage angle applies.
